articles.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Video Review - IGN
articles.summary: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort reviewed by Jesse Vitelli on Nintendo Switch 2."Nintendo Switch Sports Resort shines as the party game it’s meant to be, perfect to bring to your friend’s place or get the backyard barbeque bumping. Its single-player options widen the package with a light campaign and an amusing free exploration mode, but it’s not a big surprise that neither do quite enough to take the spotlight away from the highs of its multiplayer. And while there are a few weak games like Basketball and Power Cruising, more exciting sports like Archery, Skateboarding, and even Thumb Wrestling make this a fun and playful collection overall."
